name: audit-prep
request: Our finance team has the Progress Software quarterly expense filing. Read it, pull out the company name, the reporting period and total revenue, then write two checks an auditor could run to confirm the figures tie out.
rationale: Read the filing, extract three fields, produce two audit checks.

name: discovery-then-memo
request: Somewhere in our filings folder a company reported a 26% decline in manufacturing revenue - find which one. Then draft a short note to the risk committee about supplier concentration in a single manufacturing region.
rationale: Retrieve one fact across filings, then draft one note.

name: close-and-board-note
request: Take the Progress Software expense filing and the Franklin Covey MD&A. Compare them and tell me which figures appear in both and disagree. Then write me a board summary covering revenue performance and cost drivers.
rationale: Compare two filings, then write a board summary.
